name: PT Graha Andrasentra Propertindo Tbk
summary: PT Graha Andrasentra Propertindo Tbk engages in the development and management of recreational parks in Indonesia. It operates through four divisions: Hotel and Condotel, Real Estate, Recreation Park, and Others. The company manages Jungle recreation park, such as The Jungle Waterpark, Jungle Sea, and Rivera Outbound & Edutainment, as well as Aston Bogor hotel and resort. It also sells houses and strata title apartments. PT Graha Andrasentra Propertindo Tbk was founded in 1988 and is based in Bogor, Indonesia.
